Great fresh food and excellent break from street food overdose.
Aug 2018 • Business
After eating traditional Vietnamese street food non-stop for 12 days, I decided to put down my rice paper salad for at least a day and focus on some healthier choices. Visiting from San Jose, CA, in the states, we have our share of poke spots so I wanted something familiar to me that would remind me of home. The Poke House definitely hit the spot. This restaurant is located on the ground floor of the M Plaza, and the modern building was a nice break from sitting on 12" kiddie stools in the middle of bustling sidewalks exposed to the rainy, humid, and hot natural elements that I was getting NOT at all getting accustomed to. The Poke House was a nice break from the hustle and bustle. I really liked the step wise menu process that made ordering/choosing simple. I appreciated the brown rice option to get my fiber levels back up to par. My wife is a vegetarian, and she was extremely happy to find options to satisfy her needs. Needless to say, the fish was fresh and the employees were friendly! My wife and I found the Poke House bowls very tasty, safe, and fresh. We will be back when my arteries cry again from too much com tam ba ghien.

Nov 2017 • Friends

During a recent visit to HCM, I happen to stumble upon this restaurant and, to my surprise, was impressed by the quality of the ingredients. I'd go as far as saying this is the BEST poke restaurant I've ever tried. The staff was also very friendly. Not sure how you want to build your bowl? Just ask and they'll guide you along the way to YOUR 'Instagram worthy' perfect bowl . All in all, highly recommend this place if you're looking for healthy and clean eating.
